name: azure-query
description: Read-only Azure Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Resource Graph queries: the azure-query MCP server plus a skill that teaches Claude when and how to use each tool.

tenant_id.title: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Tenant that holds the subscriptions and workspaces to query. Leave empty to use the tenant of your current az login session.

hunting_dir.title: Hunting query folder (optional)
hunting_dir.description: Folder of SentinelCBContent-format JSON hunting queries to load alongside the built-in hunts. Leave empty for the built-in hunts only.

cloud.title: Azure cloud (optional)
cloud.description: AzurePublicCloud, AzureUSGovernment or AzureChinaCloud. Leave empty for the public cloud. With az login, also run az cloud set --name <cloud> first.

allow_cross_resource.title: Allow cross-resource queries
allow_cross_resource.description: Let queries use workspace(), app(), resource(), adx() and arg() to read beyond the workspace they are sent to. Off by default.
